subject.title: fix(compaction): emit after_compaction on no-op and use JSON-safe validator delimiters (#81925)

question: Should successful no-op compactions expose stable `after_compaction.reason` values as part of the public plugin hook contract, and should that contract be coordinated with the open compaction-summary payload work?
rationale: The code can emit a paired completion event mechanically, but deciding whether plugin consumers may rely on the proposed reason strings is a permanent public API and documentation choice.

options.title: Define and document stable no-op reasons
options.body: Accept the additive field, constrain its semantics and values, coordinate it with the related payload work, and land with exact-head validation.

options.title: Emit only the paired completion signal
options.body: Keep `compactedCount: 0` for successful no-ops but remove the new reason field until a separate plugin-hook contract proposal defines it.

options.title: Defer both payload extensions together
options.body: Pause this PR until the related compaction-summary work establishes one reviewed after-compaction payload contract.

recommendation.title: Define and document stable no-op reasons
recommendation.body: Accept the additive field, constrain its semantics and values, coordinate it with the related payload work, and land with exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the closest available history signal for the before/after compaction hook lifecycle and its plugin-facing behavior.
